description: All colors must use Synapse CSS variables. Never hardcode hex, rgb, rgba, or hsl values.
All spacing values must use Synapse spacing tokens (--spacing-space-*). Never use arbitrary pixel values.
All border-radius values must use Synapse radius tokens (--corner-radius-radius-*). Never hardcode border-radius.
All shadow values must use Synapse shadow tokens (--shadow-drop-shadow-*). Consistent shadow color: #25252514.
Typography must follow Synapse type scale: Header 1-6 (48/40/32/28/24/20px), Body 1-3 (16/14/12px). Use font-size tokens.
All interactive components must meet WCAG 2.1 AA. Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
All interactive elements must have visible focus indicators. Use --color-border-focus token for focus rings.
Components must support keyboard navigation. Tab for focus, Enter/Space for activation, Escape for dismissal.
Components must be responsive. Use Synapse breakpoints: mobile (360-576px), tablet (577-768px), small-desktop (769-1024px), desktop (1025-1440px), large (1441px+).
Elevation must follow the 5-level system: 0 (default), 1 (slight raise), 2 (filter/tooltip), 3 (selected/dropdown), 4 (modal/dialog). Use corresponding Drop Shadow tokens.
All components must support both Light and Dark themes. Use semantic color tokens that resolve to different values per theme.
Synapse color palette: 10 color families (Blue/Slate/Gray/Yellow/Red/Green/Light Blue/Purple/Berry/Orange) x 9 steps (100-900).
Buttons have 3 sizes: sm (height 28px), md (height 36px), lg (height 44px). Horizontal padding scales with size.
Button variants: Primary (filled brand), Secondary (outlined), Tertiary (text-only), Ghost (transparent), Danger (red). Each has distinct token mappings.
Disabled buttons must use reduced opacity (0.5) and cursor: not-allowed. They should not respond to click events.
Text inputs require a visible label above the field. Helper text appears below. Error text replaces helper when validation fails.
Text input focus state: 2px brand color border. Error state: red border + error text. Disabled: reduced opacity, no interaction.
Dialogs must use elevation level 4 (Drop Shadow 32). Backdrop must use --color-background-overlay. Content scrolls if overflow.
Dialogs must trap focus. Opening sets focus to first focusable element. Escape closes dialog. Focus returns to trigger on close.
Tooltips use elevation level 2 (Drop Shadow 8). Max width 320px. Arrow points to trigger. Delay: 200ms show, 0ms hide.
Toasts appear at top-right of viewport. Auto-dismiss after 5 seconds (configurable). Support 4 severity levels with distinct icons.
Tab list is horizontal. Active tab has brand-color bottom border indicator. Tab panels lazy-render by default.
Tabs use arrow keys for navigation within tab list. Tab/Shift+Tab moves focus in and out of the tab list.
Accordion items have a header with chevron icon. Content expands/collapses with smooth animation. Support single or multiple open items.
Dropdown popup uses elevation level 3 (Drop Shadow 8). Options have hover and selected states. Selected option shows check indicator.
React implementations must use Base UI (@base-ui-components/react) compound components. Do not import from other UI libraries (MUI, Radix, Chakra).
Base UI components use data-* attributes for state styling (data-checked, data-selected, data-open, data-disabled). Prefer data-attribute selectors over className toggling for states.
Base UI compound components follow Root > Parts pattern. Always use the compound API (e.g., Select.Root > Select.Trigger > Select.Popup) instead of flat props.
Use className callbacks for dynamic styling: className={(state) => `base ${state.open ? 'open' : ''}`}. This integrates with Base UI's state management.
Masthead is fixed at top. Height: 48px. Contains logo (left), navigation (center), actions (right). Uses elevation level 0 with border-bottom.
Left nav has two modes: expanded (240px) and collapsed (rail, 48px). Active item highlighted with brand color. Groups can collapse.
